**ACCEPT** — PR #10075 (head `1974a74ac`, 2 files, +47 −4), reviewed 2026-09-20T10:58Z.

`check-governed-merges.mjs --pr objectstack-ai/objectui#10075` on the FINAL file list: 0 of 2 paths hit the register → **NOT governed**, ordinary queue landing applies.

Every behavioural claim the two pages now make was re-derived here from the source, not taken from the hand-back:

| claim as written | where it is decided | reading |
|---|---|---|
| "only a declared `true` short-circuits"; `dueLike: false` does **not** suppress the field-name fallback | `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` `resolveDueLike` | `if (declared === true) return true;` then falls through to `DUE_LIKE_FIELD_NAME.test(...)` — `false` and absent take the same path |
| red starts the day after the deadline | same file, `isOverdueInstant` | `date < startOfToday` ⇒ first red at `diffDays === -1` |
| the "Overdue Nd" wording starts a day later still | `packages/core/src/utils/date-display.ts` `formatRelativeDate` | gated on `diffDays < -1` ⇒ first wording at `-2`, which is why "the shortest overdue phrase is Overdue 2d" |
| the wording stops at the ±7-day window but the red does not | same two functions | `diffDays < -7` returns the absolute face; `isOverdueInstant` is unchanged by that branch, so a long-overdue date reads as a plain past date, in red |
| the authored entry wins over the object's own `dueLike` | `packages/plugin-detail/src/fieldEnrichment.ts` `enrichDetailField` | `if (value !== undefined && enriched[key] === undefined)` — object metadata fills only the keys the entry left out, and `dueLike` is in `ENRICHED_FIELD_METADATA_KEYS` |

Two notes on the shape, both kept:

- the schema-reference entry **cites** `/docs/fields/datetime#overdue-affordance` rather than restating the rule, so the rule keeps one home;
- the DateTime page gained the two facts that citation needed in order to be complete (the two halves do not switch together; `dueLike: false` is not an opt-out). Without them the citation would have pointed at a partial rule.

The card's premise was one clause short and the hand-back corrected it: it did not say where `DetailViewField` *is* documented. The DetailViewSchema section names it in the `fields` row and teaches none of the entry's keys — which is where the note landed. Recorded so the next card of this shape names the section, not just the type.

Gates: 12 green in the worktree; on the PR head, 28 completed checks green, 4 `Test` shards still in flight at this reading (docs-only diff). `check:doc-snippets` answered `PRECONDITION NOT MET (exit 2)` — recorded as not-a-verdict, ⛔ not read as a pass. No changeset owed.

Landing: ready **early** + auto-merge, per 说明 SS. Card closes on merge via `Fixes`.

One separate finding was handed back with it — the older `type: "detail"` validator accepts `dueLike` on a `groups[].fields[]` entry and silently strips it. It is being re-verified first-hand before it becomes a card (说明 GG: 立卡也要分「自量」与「转述」), and will be filed on its own number.
